wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=TW02 | prevtitle=Training | nextcode=TW04 | nexttitle=Early-Evening Waves | series=Pokémon: Twilight Wings | colorscheme=Galar}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=TW03 | colorscheme=Galar | title_en=Buddy | title_ja=相棒 | title_ja_trans=Partner | release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=March 17, 2020 | broadcast_us=March 17, 2020 | en_op=N/A | ja_op=N/A | ja_ed=N/A | olmteam=Studio Colorido | scenario=木下爽 | storyboard=竹内雅人 | director=竹内雅人 | art=井川典恵 | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=TW01-TW07 | footnotes=* ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0cXpOnfX6I Buddy]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WDfyHg9nUQU Buddy]'' on the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * {{BMGf|279459|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''Buddy''' (Japanese: '''相棒''' ''Partner'') is the third episode of [[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]]. It was first released on the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel, the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel, and [[Pokémon TV]] on March 17, 2020. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Hop idolizes his older brother, Leon, who along with his partner Pokémon, Charizard, have earned the title of Champion. Wooloo, Hop’s partner Pokémon, is jealous of the admiration shown for Leon’s Charizard and decides to prove that it’s also worthy of the Champion title. ==Plot== [[Hop]] puts on [[Leon]]'s match against [[Bea]], hoping to learn how to become a {{pkmn|Champion}} just like his older brother. He urges his {{p|Wooloo}} to pay close attention to {{TP|Leon|Charizard}}'s techniques, and the Sheep Pokémon tries its own {{m|Flamethrower}} and flying moves. Hop laughs off Wooloo's attempts at being tough, but admits that they cannot rely on their current attacks of {{m|Tackle}} and {{m|Defense Curl}} to beat Leon anytime soon. Hop declares that they are going to keep {{pkmn|training}} by watching more of Leon's battles. However, Wooloo is unenthused by the prospect and storms out. While wandering the streets of [[Postwick]], Wooloo spots a poster of Leon and Charizard. It lets out an impersonation of Flamethrower, but this stirs up a nearby {{p|Yamper}} who proceeds to chase Wooloo around. Wooloo manages to get away, and soon spots a {{tc|Firebreather}} and his {{p|Charmander}} performing for the crowd. As Wooloo tries its own Flamethrower, a group of {{tc|Lass}}es start taking snapshots of the cute Pokémon and asking it to pose. Wooloo runs off again to escape the pressure. It soon approaches a stone ramp, and decides it'll attempt flying like Charizard. Even with a running leap, Wooloo simply plummets down the hillside and into a Wooloo paddock. The Wooloo bleat to their Trainer, the [[Turffield]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Milo]], who notices the injured Wooloo. He quickly realizes it isn’t one of his flock after seeing a tag around its neck with an address. Milo has a {{tc|Cabbie|Taxi Driver}} pick Wooloo up, though it is hesitant to return home until the Driver's {{p|Corviknight}}'s intense stare silences it. Milo waves Wooloo off, while Wooloo slumps into the cab seat feeling despondent. It reflects on seeing all the Trainers caring for the Pokémon. Wooloo turns to its friendship bracelet on its leg and is tearfully reminded of Hop. Meanwhile, Hop is searching the streets for Wooloo, but no sight of it yet. He rushes out to the surrounding paddocks and calls out for Wooloo in desperation. Flying overhead, Wooloo hears the familiar voice and pokes its head out of the side window to see Hop calling out for it. The wind suddenly picks up, breaking the friendship bracelet. The broken threads capture Hop’s attention, and he looks up to see Wooloo in the Flying Taxi. Hop then starts running after his partner, apologizing for what he said earlier. He declares that he needs Wooloo by his side and when he gets to the League. The Taxi Driver notices Hop, and orders Corviknight to land. However, Wooloo makes a leap of faith, and lands into Hop’s embrace. Happily reunited, Trainer and Pokémon affirm their friendship. Wooloo again pretends to be like Charizard, to which Hop reminds Wooloo that it is already perfect as it is. The Taxi Driver offers Hop and Wooloo a ride home, remarking that the pair certainly have a strong bond. ==Major events== [[Hop]] reunites with his {{p|Wooloo}} after running away and reaffirms their friendship. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Hop]] * [[Leon]] (television) * [[Bea]] (television) * [[Milo]] * [[Nessa]] * {{tc|Cabbie|Taxi Driver}} * {{gal|Jack}} * {{tc|Firebreather}} * {{tc|Lass}}es * Children ** {{tc|Schoolboy}} ** {{tc|Youngster}} ** {{tc|Schoolgirl}}s * Citizens ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Wooloo}} ([[Hop]]'s) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Leon|Charizard}}; television) * {{p|Machamp}} ([[Bea]]'s; television) * {{p|Corviknight}} ([[Flying Taxi]]) * {{p|Wooloo}} ([[Milo]]'s; multiple) * {{p|Indeedee}} ({{gal|Jack}}'s; female; debut) * {{p|Charmander}} ({{tc|Firebreather}}'s) * {{p|Eevee}} ({{tc|Lass}}'s) * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{tc|Lass}}'s) * {{p|Morpeko}} ({{tc|Lass}}'s; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Morpeko|Full Belly Mode}}; debut) * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{tc|Schoolboy}}'s) * {{p|Hoothoot}} ({{tc|Youngster}}'s) * {{p|Alcremie}} ({{tc|Schoolgirl}}'s; debut) * {{p|Skwovet}} ({{tc|Schoolgirl}}'s) * {{p|Butterfree}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Lotad}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Zigzagoon}} (Trainer's; [[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]; debut) * {{p|Duskull}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Minccino}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Mudbray}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Skwovet}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Greedent}} (Trainer's; debut) * {{p|Yamper}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Polteageist}} (Trainer's; debut) * {{p|Milcery}} (Trainer's; debut) * {{p|Qwilfish}} ==Trivia== * On March 8, 2020, the official English Pokémon Twitter account [https://web.archive.org/web/20200308214031/https:/twitter.com/pokemon/status/1236758515743625217 tweeted] that the third episode would be released on Tuesday, March 10, 2020, a week before its actual release.
